top_signals.summary: Saudi Arabia’s East-West pipeline had moved 5.8 million barrels of crude as of Tuesday morning, Energy Minister Prince Abdulaziz bin Salman said, adding more oil to the kingdom’s Red Sea export route as Gulf producers continue working around the Strait of Hormuz. The pipeline carries crude across Saudi Arabia to Yanbu on the Red Sea. Riyadh had been moving roughly 4 million barrels per day through the system after the Iran war disrupted normal exports through Hormuz.
